title: 🌙 Moonlit Bellarose
description: A romantic festival story of letters, music, and second chances in the cliffside town of Bellarose

nodes.label: Arrival
text: 🌙 Bellarose glows under strings of lantern light as you arrive at the old glass conservatory with dust on your cuffs and salt in the air.
Aunt Mireille is waiting with pruning shears, and somewhere beyond the square a violin rises in a melody you have not heard since your last summer here.

nodes.label: First Turn
text: 🎐 The festival has already begun. Mireille points toward the conservatory doors, the pier shimmers below the cliff, and the market bells ring from the square.
Somewhere in that bright confusion is Julien Marceau, the almost-love Bellarose never quite let you forget.

nodes.label: Glass Doors
text: 🌿 You slip inside the conservatory and catch Julien on a ladder, tying moon-silver ribbon between iron arches.
He looks down, startled, then smiles as if he had been expecting you and only forgot to admit it to himself.

nodes.label: Pier Glimpse
text: 🌊 At the pier, lantern boats knock gently against the wood while Julien tunes his violin for the evening launch.
When he sees you on the steps, his bow stills in midair, and the years between your last goodbye seem to fold like paper.

nodes.label: Market Glimpse
text: 🛍️ The market is all roses, sugared almonds, and silk masks. Julien is bargaining with Inez over ribbon colors when he turns and finds you in the crowd.
The laugh that leaves him is soft and disbelieving, as if Bellarose has handed him a secret he wanted back.

nodes.label: First Words
text: 💫 Julien closes the distance with careful slowness. "You came back," he says, like he is testing whether hope sounds safer out loud.
The town noise fades, leaving only the two of you and the pulse of everything unsaid.

nodes.label: Soft Return
text: 🤍 You smile before you can help it, and Julien answers with the same old crooked warmth that once ruined your ability to stay sensible.
"Then Bellarose is luckier than usual tonight," he murmurs.

nodes.label: Bright Tease
text: 😏 "You still greet people like a confession," you say. Julien laughs, color touching his cheeks.
"Only the dangerous ones," he replies, and the answer lands closer to your heart than you planned.

nodes.label: Held Breath
text: 🫶 You keep your voice steady, but Julien notices the caution instantly and lets his own smile soften into patience.
"We can begin again slowly," he says. "I know better than to rush you this time."

nodes.label: Festival Pull
text: 🎭 A burst of festival noise swallows the moment. Mireille calls for help with the vines, Celia waves from the lantern steps, and Inez runs past chasing a silver mask.
Bellarose has a way of deciding that tenderness must survive interruption before it is trusted.

nodes.label: Vine Duty
text: 🌿 Aunt Mireille presses twine and pruning gloves into your hands, pretending not to notice how often Julien glances your way from the roses.
"If romance wants space," she says dryly, "it can help me train these moonflowers first."

nodes.label: Lantern Errand
text: 🕯️ Celia recruits you to carry lantern oil to the pier, grinning like someone who enjoys being useful at exactly the wrong moment.
Julien follows with a crate of candles, and suddenly the short walk feels suspiciously like a gift.

nodes.label: Mask Chase
text: 🎭 Inez nearly collides with you and thrusts a silver mask into your hands before darting after the rest of her runaway ribbons.
Julien reaches for the same mask a beat later, your fingers brushing over cool painted enamel.

nodes.label: Afternoon Choice
text: 🌤️ The interruption settles into laughter instead of disappointment. Julien tucks a stray ribbon into his pocket and asks how you want to spend the next hour.
His tone is casual, but Bellarose teaches you to hear longing under lightness.

nodes.label: Near Work
text: 🌿 You stay near the conservatory, sorting ivy and polishing cloudy panes while Julien works within arm's reach.
Every brushed shoulder feels accidental only if you are generous enough to lie to yourself.

nodes.label: Pier Walk
text: 🌊 You drift down the promenade together, speaking of small things until the silence between them turns warm instead of awkward.
Julien points out the best place to watch the lantern boats and remembers, annoyingly well, how you take your tea.

nodes.label: Market Stroll
text: 🛍️ You wander the market with Julien at your side, sharing sugared pear slices and pausing at every glittering booth.
He keeps choosing things he thinks you'll like, then pretending each choice was chance.

nodes.label: Gentle Questions
text: 🎻 A breeze carries violin notes from the square, and the conversation tilts toward the things neither of you has named yet.
You can ask about the summer you left, the Paris rumor circling him, or keep the hour bright a little longer.

nodes.label: Summer Echo
text: 🕰️ Julien studies the sea before answering. "I kept thinking you would write," he says, not accusing, only honest.
The quiet hurts because it deserves to.

nodes.label: Paris Whisper
text: 🚆 At the word Paris, Julien's expression flickers. "It is an offer," he admits, "not a promise."
Then he adds, almost too softly, "I have not decided what kind of life I want it to buy."

nodes.label: Bright Deflect
text: ✨ You steer the talk toward festival gossip, and Julien lets you, though the look he gives you is tender with patience.
"All right," he says. "We can borrow one easy hour before Bellarose asks for honesty again."

nodes.label: Bell Chorus
text: 🔔 The chapel bells ring for the afternoon parade, and the square breaks apart into moving silk, petals, and street musicians.
You lose Julien for one breath, then two, and the town offers three possible ways to find him again.

nodes.label: Garden Turn
text: 🌹 The crowd spills you toward the cliff garden, where Julien waits beside a trellis of white roses as if he guessed you would choose the quieter path.
"There you are," he says, relief too quick to hide.

nodes.label: Pastry Note
text: 🥐 Theo intercepts you with flour on his sleeves and mischief in his smile. "Looking for Julien? Then you might want this first."
He passes you a folded note edged with pressed petals.

nodes.label: Promenade Loop
text: 🌊 The crowd sweeps you clear to the promenade before you can protest, leaving you laughing breathlessly at Bellarose's terrible sense of timing.
When you look up, the sea is beside you and finding Julien means beginning that walk again.

nodes.label: Folded Note
text: 💌 The note is unmistakably Julien's hand, but the seal is still closed and slightly rain-smudged.
You can open it now, return it untouched, or keep it close until evening.

nodes.label: Opened Heart
text: 📖 Inside is only a line: "If Bellarose gives me courage, meet me where the glass catches sunset."
The simplicity of it makes your pulse jump harder than a speech would have.

nodes.label: Honest Return
text: 🤲 You find Julien near the flower cart and offer the note back unopened. His surprise melts into gratitude.
"Then I will have to be brave in person," he says, voice gone low.

nodes.label: Hidden Promise
text: 🌙 You slip the note into your pocket without opening it. The secret of it warms against your palm all afternoon.
When Julien catches you touching the folded paper later, his smile turns helplessly hopeful.

nodes.label: Sunset Route
text: 🌇 As the light turns honey-gold, Julien asks where you want the evening to begin.
He offers the conservatory at sunset, the pier at lantern launch, or the rehearsal hall before the waltz.

nodes.label: Golden Glass
text: 🏛️ Inside the conservatory, the fading sun turns every pane into liquid amber and lays stripes of light across Julien's sleeves.
He looks suddenly younger there, and far more dangerous to your composure.

nodes.label: Lantern Glow
text: 🕯️ At the pier, lanterns are being lit one by one, each flame mirrored in the darkening water.
Julien walks close enough for your hands to brush whenever the steps narrow.

nodes.label: Empty Hall
text: 🎼 The rehearsal hall is almost empty, save for scattered sheet music and Julien's violin case resting open like a held breath.
He plays three quiet bars just for you, and the room changes shape around the sound.

nodes.label: Summer Rain
text: ☔ Bellarose weather changes with theatrical timing. Rain sweeps over the festival in a silver curtain, sending everyone running for cover.
Whether you shelter together or lose a few precious minutes to the storm depends entirely on where the crowd breaks.

nodes.label: Shared Shelter
text: ☔ You and Julien duck beneath the conservatory arcade, laughing as rain freckles your sleeves and hair.
He reaches out to brush a wet strand from your temple, then seems unable to remember why he should stop.

nodes.label: Separate Shelter
text: 🌧️ The crowd cuts between you, and by the time you reach shelter Julien is across the lane under striped awning light.
He lifts two fingers in apology, all fondness and frustration across the rain.

nodes.label: Near Confession
text: 💞 When the rain softens, Julien steps closer with the look of a man standing at the edge of a sentence he has rewritten too many times.
You can press for the truth, answer with touch, or let the moment stay unfinished.

nodes.label: Plain Truth
text: 💬 "What were you going to say?" you ask. Julien exhales and almost smiles at your courage.
"That I made leaving you once look easier than it was," he admits.

nodes.label: Gentle Touch
text: 🤍 Your fingers find his hand before your caution can object. Julien holds on with immediate, startled tenderness.
Whatever words fail him, his pulse does not.

nodes.label: Unfinished Breath
text: 🙂 You save him from the edge of confession, and gratitude mixes strangely with regret in his eyes.
"Then give me another chance later," he says.

nodes.label: Morning Plans
text: 🌤️ The next morning opens bright and salt-sweet, with half the town already shouting about festival lists and missing ribbons.
You can help Celia ready the lantern boats, join Inez at the mask atelier, or meet Julien early inside the conservatory.

nodes.label: Boat Morning
text: 🕯️ Celia has you knotting silver cords to paper lanterns while she watches you over the rims like a patient older sister.
"If he looks at you any more obviously," she says, "I may charge him pier fees."

nodes.label: Mask Morning
text: 🎭 Inez's atelier smells like glue, lilies, and crushed velvet. She fits masks against your face while speculating shamelessly about kisses.
Somehow the silver half-mask she chooses makes you feel braver.

nodes.label: Early Glass
text: 🌿 Julien is already inside the conservatory, sleeves rolled, coaxing a stubborn moonflower vine along the iron ribs.
In the cool morning hush, being alone with him feels more intimate than last night's storm.

nodes.label: Scattered Envelopes
text: 💌 A gust barrels through the lane and lifts half a stack of festival envelopes into the air like startled birds.
You lunge after them, but Bellarose decides whether the missing note lands with you, with Theo, or back at the atelier.

nodes.label: Fountain Catch
text: ⛲ One envelope slaps wetly against the fountain rim. Inside is a short invitation written in Julien's hand: "Observatory steps at noon, if you come."
The paper smells faintly of cedar and rain.

nodes.label: Theo's Grin
text: 🥐 Theo snatches a drifting envelope before it hits a tart stand and hands it over with a knowing grin.
"He really should learn subtler methods," he says, but his voice is kind.

nodes.label: Noon Answer
text: 📝 Julien's invitation feels simple until it doesn't. Accepting means stepping closer to whatever Bellarose is building between you.
You can send a written reply, go in person without one, or keep your answer to yourself until noon.

nodes.label: Written Reply
text: ✍️ You write only, "I will come if courage keeps pace with me." Celia volunteers to deliver it with indecent enthusiasm.
When Julien reads it across the square, he smiles into the paper.

nodes.label: Quiet Resolve
text: 🚶 You choose not to hide behind ink and spend the morning doing everything a little too carefully.
The anticipation of seeing Julien makes even folding ribbon feel like a dangerous act.

nodes.label: Pocket Secret
text: 🤫 You keep the invitation tucked close, answering no one and nothing.
The silence sharpens your thoughts instead of calming them.

nodes.label: Noon Paths
text: 🌤️ Noon arrives with church shade on the square and sunlight blazing on the cliffs.
You can reach the observatory by the rose garden, the bakery terrace, or the rehearsal corridor.

nodes.label: Rose Steps
text: 🌹 The garden path winds through climbing roses and warm stone, making every step feel chosen instead of accidental.
Julien meets you halfway and slows as if afraid of hurrying something fragile.

nodes.label: Terrace Pause
text: 🥐 Theo catches you on the bakery terrace, presses a sugared apricot into your hand, and says, "For stamina, not nerves."
His teasing leaves you smiling when you continue upward.

nodes.label: Music Passage
text: 🎼 The rehearsal corridor is lined with old posters and drifting scales from distant practice rooms.
Julien waits beside a cracked mirror, violin tucked under one arm, looking almost unbearably hopeful.

nodes.label: Rumor Thread
text: 🗣️ Before either of you can speak properly, a ribbon of gossip whips through the corridor: Madame Sabine D'Orsay has arrived, and Paris is suddenly everyone's favorite word.
The rumor can harden into fear, soften through a friend, or send you back to the garden to breathe.

nodes.label: Sabine Shadow
text: 🖤 You glimpse Sabine below in pearl silk, speaking to a hotel manager with the calm certainty of someone used to arranging other people's futures.
The sight makes Julien's unopened explanation feel suddenly urgent.

nodes.label: Celia's Spin
text: 🌼 Celia finds you first and rolls her eyes at the gossip. "Rumor loves pretty lighting," she says.
Still, even she cannot quite deny there is a real offer somewhere inside the noise.

nodes.label: Rumor Answer
text: 🎻 Julien sees the worry land on your face and opens his mouth, but this time you can choose the shape of the moment.
You can confront him now, trust him enough to wait, or bury yourself in work until your heart steadies.

nodes.label: Hard Question
text: 🔥 "Are you leaving?" you ask with more force than grace. Julien flinches, then nods once.
"I was considering it," he says. "That is not the same as wanting to lose this."

nodes.label: Chosen Patience
text: 🤍 You let your fear loosen instead of harden. "Then tell me when you are ready," you say.
The relief in Julien's face is so immediate it almost counts as an answer.

nodes.label: Rose Labor
text: 🌿 You return to the conservatory and throw yourself into pruning and tying until your hands smell green and sharp.
Julien does not interrupt, but the fact that he comes to help says enough.

nodes.label: Festival Errands
text: 🎐 By afternoon, everyone is assigning tasks with suspicious strategic generosity.
Inez needs a final mask fitting, Mireille needs flowers set along the aisle, and Julien asks if you can look over his waltz score.

nodes.label: Silver Mask
text: 🎭 Inez fits the silver half-mask against your cheek and nods as if approving a duel.
"Good," she says. "Now if he hesitates, at least you can look devastating while waiting."

nodes.label: White Roses
text: 🌸 Mireille hands you white climbing roses and makes you loop them over iron arches until the whole conservatory smells like summer memory.
She never asks what you feel, which somehow makes it easier to feel it.

nodes.label: Margin Notes
text: 🎼 Julien's score is full of small pencil notes and one line in the margin that simply reads, "Don't rush the turn."
You suspect he meant the music. You are not certain he meant only the music.

nodes.label: Parade Crush
text: 🎺 The evening parade rolls through Bellarose in a thunder of brass, satin banners, and cheering children.
It can sweep you toward the promenade, push you into the ballroom queue, or spit you back toward the errands you thought you had already finished.

nodes.label: Seaside Pause
text: 🌊 The promenade opens before you in blue dusk and lantern light. Celia is there, elbows on the rail, guarding a private moment with suspicious tenderness.
"You know he listens for your footsteps," she says without looking over.

nodes.label: Ballroom Queue
text: 💃 The ballroom corridor is all perfume, candlelight, and muffled strings. Julien is waiting beside the door as if the crush of guests never touched him.
When he sees you, the whole room seems to become background.

nodes.label: Evening Ask
text: 🌙 Julien offers you three versions of the same question: a private waltz before the guests arrive, an honest talk about Paris, or a quiet walk above the sea.
Whatever you choose, the ease between you is gone now; in its place is something truer.

nodes.label: Private Waltz
text: 💃 In the empty ballroom, Julien counts softly and guides you into the turn with maddening gentleness.
When your bodies settle into the same rhythm, you understand why some people confuse dancing with confession.

nodes.label: Clear Answer
text: 🚆 Julien does not dodge this time. "Paris is brilliant," he says, "but brilliance is not the same as home."
Then he looks at you with a steadiness that feels almost like a vow.

nodes.label: Sea Air
text: 🌊 You walk the cliff path while the first lamps come alive below. Julien speaks more easily in motion, as though honesty needs the sea at its shoulder.
By the time you stop, the silence between you is full, not empty.

nodes.label: Firework Break
text: 🎆 The first fireworks leap over the harbor, startling everyone on the cliff path and scattering the evening into bright fragments.
You might reach a quiet terrace together, get separated on the staircase, or be pulled back toward the promenade by the crowd.

nodes.label: Quiet Terrace
text: 🎆 A hidden terrace above the ballroom catches the fireworks in perfect reflection across its glass doors.
Julien laughs once, softly, and says, "Bellarose never did know how to make anything subtle."

nodes.label: Staircase Gap
text: 🪜 The guest crowd cuts between you on the staircase, and by the time you reach the top Julien is two landings away.
He leaves his glove on the rail for you to find, which is either absurdly romantic or completely unfair.

nodes.label: Dawn Promise
text: 🌅 Before you part, Julien asks if you will meet him at dawn, when the old observatory opens for the festival's first light viewing.
You can promise to come, stay with Mireille's conservatory work, or ask Theo for one last measure of advice.

nodes.label: Spoken Promise
text: 🔭 You say yes before caution can stage an objection. Julien's shoulders ease as though he had been holding that breath since yesterday.
"Then dawn will be kinder than usual," he says.

nodes.label: Necessary Duty
text: 🌿 Mireille needs help before sunrise with the moonflower trellis, and you agree because love is never the only thing asking for your hands.
Still, the choice tastes bittersweet before it is even made.

nodes.label: Theo's Counsel
text: 🥐 Theo listens while icing tiny lemon cakes, then points the spoon at you like a magistrate.
"Go where your heart speaks clearly," he says. "And if it stays silent, that is an answer too."

nodes.label: Mist Delay
text: 🌫️ Dawn rolls in under a veil of sea mist, turning every lane into a guess.
You might reach Julien at the observatory, find him instead by the pier, or lose precious minutes to conservatory duty and circle back.

nodes.label: Observatory Light
text: 🔭 The observatory dome opens above you like a silver eyelid. Julien is already there, hands curled around two cups of hot tea.
In the pale light, neither of you looks inclined to pretend this meeting is casual.

nodes.label: Pier Apology
text: 🌊 The mist misleads you to the pier first, where Julien waits with damp hair and a rueful smile.
"I thought Bellarose might do something dramatic," he says. "It rarely disappoints."

nodes.label: Future Talk
text: ☀️ With dawn brightening around you, the question of what comes after the festival finally stands in the open.
You can ask Julien to stay, offer to leave with him, or demand the plain truth before hope grows any larger.

nodes.label: Rooted Wish
text: 🏡 When you ask whether he could stay, Julien looks out over Bellarose as though measuring love against habit and history.
"I could," he says. "The harder question is whether I would be brave enough to choose it."

nodes.label: Bold Offer
text: 🚆 "Then I could leave with you," you say, surprising yourself first. Julien's gaze snaps to yours.
Whatever fear he carried softens into wonder.

nodes.label: Plain Terms
text: 💬 "No more almost," you say. Julien nods like a man relieved to be caught.
"Then the truth is this," he answers. "I want you in whatever life I choose next."

nodes.label: Day Two
text: 🌤️ Bellarose gives you only a few hours to absorb that before festival business closes in again.
You can inspect the lantern route with Celia, help Julien shape the final waltz, or read the old guest book in the conservatory office.

nodes.label: Lantern Route
text: 🕯️ Celia walks you along the boat line, pointing out where the current usually swings lanterns toward the bridge.
"Useful knowledge," she says innocently, which means it is probably not innocent at all.

nodes.label: Shared Music
text: 🎼 Julien plays phrases until you begin correcting him by instinct, and soon the two of you are building a turn in the music that feels like a smile made audible.
He watches your face more than the notes.

nodes.label: Old Pages
text: 📚 The guest book is full of pressed petals, smudged signatures, and love notes disguised as room requests.
One tucked page bears Mireille's neat hand beside the name of Julien's late mother.

nodes.label: Loose Pages
text: 📜 A draft snakes through the office and sends old paper slipping across the floor.
You might catch the most revealing page, get an explanation from Mireille instead, or lose the clue and end up back on the lantern route.

nodes.label: Hidden History
text: 💞 The loose page describes a love that almost left Bellarose for the city and chose, at the last minute, to stay long enough for a whole life.
Seeing the names makes your chest tighten with recognition.

nodes.label: Mireille's Story
text: 🌼 Mireille gently takes the papers from your hands and tells you the rest herself.
"Love is not ruined by hesitation," she says. "Only by silence kept too long."

nodes.label: Brave Admit
text: 💗 The afternoon feels suddenly too short for pretense.
You can tell Celia what you want, tell Julien outright before night falls, or write your feelings into a letter first so your courage has something to hold.

nodes.label: Friend's Blessing
text: 🕯️ Celia listens without interruption, then squeezes your wrist hard enough to mean it.
"Good," she says. "Wanting something clearly is half the rescue."

nodes.label: Interrupted Truth
text: ❤️ You find Julien by the ballroom doors and start to speak, but Sabine arrives before the second sentence can survive.
The frustration in his eyes matches your own.

nodes.label: Written Courage
text: ✍️ You write by the fountain arcade until the page stops trembling beneath your hand.
The letter is not polished, only honest, which feels more dangerous.

nodes.label: Sabine Arrives
text: 🖤 Madame Sabine D'Orsay steps into the square in pearl silk, carrying herself like a verdict wrapped in lace.
You can greet her politely, hide your letter before she sees it, or challenge her cool confidence outright.

nodes.label: Polite Masks
text: 🎩 You greet Sabine with faultless manners. She studies you as if assessing a role someone forgot to announce.
Her smile is elegant enough to cut.

nodes.label: Crumpled Secret
text: 📄 You tuck the letter away too quickly, and Sabine notices anyway.
Her amusement is subtle, which somehow makes it worse.

nodes.label: Sharp Reply
text: 🔥 "Bellarose is not a waiting room for Paris," you say before diplomacy can stop you.
Sabine's brows lift, interested rather than offended.

nodes.label: Satin Current
text: 🧵 Sabine turns the conversation with practiced ease, and suddenly the entire square feels arranged around her.
She can draw you toward a Paris invitation, trap you in polite business talk, or let you slip away long enough to steady yourself with the letter.

nodes.label: Golden Offer
text: ✨ Sabine gestures toward Julien and speaks of salons, orchestras, and a life large enough to swallow any smaller dream whole.
The future she paints is dazzling, which is exactly what makes it dangerous.

nodes.label: Small Talk
text: 🫖 Sabine asks about the conservatory as though it were a charming hobby and not a living promise.
Julien's jaw tightens so slightly only someone studying him would see it.

nodes.label: Answer Sabine
text: 🎻 Sabine finally turns to you with direct curiosity. "And what do you imagine for him?" she asks.
You can defend Bellarose, hold your silence and watch Julien answer, or ask him to choose with his own voice.

nodes.label: Home Spoken
text: 🌹 You speak of moonflowers, stubborn towns, and lives that matter because they are tended, not because they are admired from afar.
Julien looks at you as if you have named him more truly than anyone in months.

nodes.label: Costly Silence
text: 🤐 You say nothing, and the emptiness lands heavier than any argument.
Julien's face shutters for a moment before he smooths it away.

nodes.label: Chosen Voice
text: 🗣️ "He can answer for himself," you say. Julien straightens, almost grateful.
"Then hear me clearly," he tells Sabine. "I am not merchandise."

nodes.label: Aftershock
text: 🌙 Once Sabine drifts away, the air feels charged and fragile.
You can ask Julien to meet you in the greenhouse, clear your head together by the sea, or rehearse one last time before the lantern waltz.

nodes.label: Greenhouse Truth
text: 🌿 In the greenhouse, moonflowers are just beginning to open, white petals unfurling like withheld answers.
Julien apologizes for every time fear made him sound uncertain.

nodes.label: Sea Clarity
text: 🌊 The cliff path is cooler now, and the salt wind strips some of the panic from your thoughts.
Julien walks beside you without rushing, as if he finally understands that pace can be a form of devotion.

nodes.label: Last Rehearsal
text: 🎼 The final rehearsal lasts only minutes, but the duet between your silence and his violin says everything the room cannot.
When the last note fades, no one applauds because no one dares break it.

nodes.label: Final Night
text: 🕯️ The last lanterns are being carried toward the bridge, the station lights glitter below the cliff road, and the conservatory doors stand open behind you.
Bellarose has done all it can. The rest must be chosen.

nodes.label: Bridge Choice
text: 🌉 On the lantern bridge, water flickers gold beneath the rails and Julien waits without disguise or distance.
You can speak now and choose him openly, ask for one season of letters instead of promises, or let the beautiful moment remain unfinished.

nodes.label: Paris Waltz
text: 🚉 You catch Julien by the station steps and choose motion over fear. He laughs once, stunned, then kisses you like someone stepping into weather he has wanted all along.
By dawn the train is carrying both of you toward Paris, not because the city won, but because love finally stopped pretending it wanted safety first.

nodes.label: Steady Bloom
text: 🌱 You turn back toward the conservatory and choose the life with roots under it. Mireille meets you at the doors, and Julien lets you go with sorrow, respect, and a promise not to call this ending when it is only truth.
Moonflowers open above you as Bellarose keeps you, and for the first time that choice feels like its own kind of romance.

nodes.label: Bellarose Kiss
text: ❤️ You tell Julien to stay, and then tell him you love him before caution can edit the sentence. His answer comes as laughter, tears, and a kiss under swinging lantern light.
By sunrise you are planning roses, music, and a reopened conservatory together, with Bellarose glittering around your impossible good luck.

nodes.label: Season Letters
text: 💌 You ask for one honest season instead of a perfect forever. Julien presses his forehead to yours and agrees, relieved that love can be brave without pretending certainty.
Lantern boats drift under the bridge while you trade the first of many letters, each one a promise to return more clearly than before.

nodes.label: Missed Tide
text: 🌫️ You let the moment pass with a soft smile, and Julien understands enough not to force what your heart cannot yet hold.
The bridge glows, the music fades, and Bellarose keeps the memory gentle: not a ruin, only a love that arrived a little too close to the tide.
